meta.title: Buyer discovers suppliers with Vendor Finder and invites one

args.goal: On the Vendors tab, click the "✨ Vendor Finder" button next to "Start Onboarding", use a ready-made prompt in the "Smart Supplier Scout" side panel, click the blue search icon, verify vendor cards are displayed, click "Select" on a vendor card, click "Invite All Selected", and stop when the screen shows that the invitation was successfully sent and the vendor is treated as a prospective supplier

steps.note: Performs the Vendor Finder discovery and invitation flow that no domain step represents, including the required vendor-card and prospective-supplier outcome.
Verifies the expected invitation-sent confirmation is visible after inviting the selected vendor.
